metadata.title: High-Assurance / Amplifying Integration SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining elevated trust, governance, and lifecycle requirements for high-assurance and amplifying system-to-system integrations.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all Secure-Integration Platform trust semantics and introduces stricter constraints for integrations that amplify trust, risk, or impact.

system-characteristics.system-description: High-Assurance Integration environments include integrations that amplify trust, effects, or blast radius across systems and time. These integrations require stricter authorization, reduced replay tolerance, constrained fan-out, and explicit lifecycle revocation.

props.name: integration-trust-tier
props.remarks: Indicates an integration class with elevated systemic impact and amplification risk.

props.name: amplification-scope
props.remarks: Producer scope, consumer scope, and fan-out must be explicitly bounded and approved.

props.name: replay-policy
props.remarks: Replay of retained messages or events requires explicit authorization and heightened scrutiny.

props.name: retention-tolerance
props.remarks: Message and event retention is minimized to reduce temporal attack surface.

props.name: schema-drift-tolerance
props.remarks: Schema and contract changes require strict compatibility and governance review.

props.name: lifecycle-policy
props.remarks: Integration trust must be explicitly revoked upon deprecation, ownership change, or misuse.

props.name: non-equivalence-enforcement
props.remarks: Relying systems must strictly enforce non-equivalence between integration trust and business authorization.

system-implementation.remarks: High-Assurance Integration environments rely on the full Secure-Integration signal stack with stricter interpretation thresholds and reduced tolerance for amplification, replay, or semantic ambiguity. This SSPP does not define remediation, tooling, or operational procedures.

roles.title: High-Assurance Integration Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines elevated trust architecture and constraints for amplifying integration surfaces.

roles.title: High-Assurance Integration Governance
roles.remarks: Approves amplification scope, replay authorization, retention limits, and trust revocation decisions.

roles.title: High-Assurance Integration Operations
roles.remarks: Operates high-impact integration platforms under stricter trust and lifecycle constraints.

roles.title: High-Assurance Integration Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors amplification, replay misuse, lifecycle violations, and trust degradation events.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through inheritance from Secure-Integration patterns with stricter trust interpretation and governance. This SSPP introduces no new control implementations.
